_source: Built mechanically from the facts of CBP ruling N338219 (2024-03-08, development Part 102 split; subject: "The tariff classification and country of origin of an adapter plate assembly"). D570 rules on development data for the D590 error analysis. CBP held Mexico. Components: the D362 materials; part codes: the top D381 development suggestion (unverified, D382); the good's code: CBP's (8708.99.8180). Family: the family check (vehicle_parts, 0.9); name from the subject (D381 rule). Materials with no country left out (1: M4 Screws). Groups: one model call with the production extractor's group rule (groups-dev-set.jsonl). Plants one per country; operations one per group and plant plus final assembly in Mexico. Target South Korea by the D171 rule counted mechanically; plant capabilities for South Korea are an assumption. Economics illustrative. D590.
